propositions: The merge-abort recovery toolkit is implemented twice in sync.py and push_recovery.py, causing maintenance drift and parallel bugs landing one at a time
The quarantine mover exists as sync._quarantine_untracked (no untracked fence) and push_recovery._quarantine_untracked_paths (with git status fence), diverging in safety checks
Both sync.py and push_recovery.py need late-bindable git runner callables to work with module-level _git and monkeypatched core._git respectively
A shared merge_recovery.py module with pure recovery functions and a single untracked-fence-enforcing mover eliminates duplication while preserving both call sites' patch points
The uniqueness guard construction verifies exactly one quarantine mover exists under src/rebar by matching the conjunction of shutil.move/copy2 and quarantine identifier with mandatory reason marker
